description: Translate all Chinese passages in skill markdowns to PT-BR. There are 15 SKILL.md files plus skills/omk-debugging/investigation-template.md (42 CJK lines). Most of the Chinese is in `## Trigger Examples` lists, body prose, and the investigation template's table cells / placeholders. The YAML front-matter (including the `description:` value with its Chinese trigger keywords like '改代码', '修复', '生成 PDF', '设计稿', '看看这个视频') MUST remain byte-identical because hooks/feedback/context-enrichment.sh and the skill router pattern-match against it.
steps: For each of the 15 SKILL.md files (skills/omk-agent, omk-coding, omk-context7-docs, omk-debugging, omk-finishing, omk-know, omk-pdf-gen, omk-planning, omk-research, omk-reviewing, omk-self-reflect, omk-skill-creation, omk-stitch, omk-verification, omk-youtube): identify the front-matter block (between the first two `---` lines) and DO NOT TOUCH IT. Translate every Chinese line in the body to PT-BR.

Trigger Examples lists are the most common place: `- "帮我实现这个功能"` -> `- "me ajude a implementar essa funcionalidade"`, `- "重构一下这段代码"` -> `- "refatore esse trecho de codigo"`, `- "修复 PR review 发现的问题"` -> `- "corrija os problemas apontados no PR review"`, etc. These are user-facing examples - translate naturally to PT-BR with `voce`-style address. Keep technical tokens (`PR review`, `hook`, `model`, `worktree`, `submodule`, etc.) in English.

Edit skills/omk-debugging/investigation-template.md: this is a structured template with HTML comments containing Chinese instructions, table headers and cells with placeholders, and a status legend. Translate every Chinese sentence and placeholder. Keep verbatim: HTML comment markers (`<!-- ... -->`), heading anchors, emoji (🔒 🔴 🟡 🟢 ⚡ ⬜ ❌ ✅ 🤖 👤), the literals `L0`, `L1`, `L2`, `F1`, `H1`, `I1`, `D1`, `R1`, `EXP-001` (these are referenced as identifier patterns), table column structure, and the `{date}` `{time}` `{title}` `{conclusion}` placeholders. The investigation template is consumed by skills/omk-debugging body prose; rendered output examples in tests should remain compatible. Translate the section bodies (`## Problem Statement`, `## Status Overview`, etc. - keep English headings) keeping table structure exactly the same width/columns. Confidence levels `高/中/低` -> `alto/medio/baixo`.

After editing, verify EACH skill front-matter byte-equality: `for f in skills/omk-*/SKILL.md; do diff <(awk '/^---$/{c++; if(c==2){print; exit} } c{print}' "$f") <(git show main:"$f" | awk '/^---$/{c++; if(c==2){print; exit} } c{print}'); done` - must produce no output.
Verify no Chinese remains in any skill file: `grep -P -l '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' skills/omk-*/SKILL.md skills/omk-debugging/investigation-template.md` - must return nothing.
Run pytest and the bash test harnesses; counts must match baseline exactly.
Stage and commit only files under skills/ with message: `docs(i18n): translate skill markdowns CN -> pt-BR`. `git diff --stat HEAD~1` should only list paths under skills/.
acceptance_criteria: Every SKILL.md YAML front-matter (between the two `---` lines) is byte-identical to the version on `main`.
Zero CJK characters remain in any file under skills/.
All test-anchored literals still present (Skill Routing, Authority Matrix, etc. live in templates/, not skills/, but check anyway).
pytest, tests/test-agents-template.sh, tests/knowledge/run.sh counts unchanged from baseline.
git diff main HEAD --name-only contains only paths under skills/ for this commit (plus the prior commits).
verification: Run `for f in skills/omk-*/SKILL.md; do head=$(awk '/^---$/{c++; if(c==2){print NR; exit} } c{print}' "$f" | head -1); if ! diff -q <(sed -n '1,/^---$/p;/^---$/q' "$f") <(git show main:"$f" | sed -n '1,/^---$/p;/^---$/q') > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo FRONTMATTER DRIFT: $f; fi; done` - prints nothing.
Run pytest with the documented ignore set - tail must contain `8 failed, 60 passed`.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` - must end with `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.
Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10` - must contain `Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total`.
findings: Translated CN passages to PT-BR in commit 480e551 across 16 files under skills/ (106 insertions, 106 deletions). Files: skills/omk-{agent,coding,context7-docs,debugging,finishing,know,pdf-gen,planning,research,reviewing,self-reflect,skill-creation,stitch,verification,youtube}/SKILL.md and skills/omk-debugging/investigation-template.md. Front-matter byte-equality check passed for every SKILL.md (the description: values that contain runtime trigger keywords like '改代码', '修复', '加个', '改一下', '优化', '生成 PDF', '导出 PDF', '做个 PDF', '设计稿', '设计.*代码', '视觉.*对比', '看看这个视频', '创建 skill', '写个 skill' remain byte-identical, as required by hooks/feedback/context-enrichment.sh). All Trigger Examples bullet lists translated naturally with voce-style address; technical English tokens (PR review, hook, model, worktree, submodule, Stitch) kept in English. The investigation-template.md was rewritten with PT-BR HTML comments, table headers and cells while preserving identifiers L0/L1/L2, F1/H1/I1/D1/R1/EXP-001, emoji (🔒🔴🟡🟢⚡⬜❌✅🤖👤), placeholder slots ({date}, {time}, {title}, {conclusion}), and exact table column structure. Confidence levels translated alto/medio/baixo. Chinese punctuation normalised to ASCII. No em dashes added. Residual CJK in skills/ (per `grep -P -l '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' -r skills/`): 5 files (omk-coding, omk-pdf-gen, omk-skill-creation, omk-stitch, omk-youtube) all of which contain CJK ONLY inside YAML front-matter description/triggers values (pattern-matched runtime literals that must remain verbatim) plus one occurrence in omk-skill-creation:45 inside a fenced code block (verbatim per rule D). All baselines preserved: pytest 8 failed / 60 passed; tests/test-agents-template.sh 27 passed / 1 failed; tests/knowledge/run.sh 1 pass / 3 total. The verification step `grep -P -l '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' skills/` is not strictly empty but every remaining occurrence is in a protected region (front-matter or code fence) per translation-rules-cn.md sections C, D - this is the intended outcome and matches the constraint that front-matter must be byte-identical.
